space_combat.name: Space Combat
space_combat.description: Lucian Alliance ships attack Destiny. Man the weapons systems and defend the ship.

boarding.name: Boarding Action
boarding.description: Enemy soldiers have breached the hull. Fight them off in the corridors.

room_defense.name: Key Room Defense
room_defense.description: Hold the critical rooms. If the enemy captures the gate room or control interface, all is lost.

moral_choice.name: The Choice
moral_choice.description: The Lucian Alliance commander offers terms: surrender the ship and live, or fight on and risk everything.

surrender.label: Surrender the Destiny
surrender.description: Hand over the ship to Kiva and the Lucian Alliance. The crew will be prisoners — but alive.

fight.label: Fight On
fight.description: Refuse the offer. Push the enemy back and retake the ship. Many may die.

cliffhanger.name: Cliffhanger
cliffhanger.description: As the dust settles, Destiny drops out of FTL — and something impossible appears on the sensors.
